title: digitaria filiformis var. prostrata
intro: Digitaria filiformis var. prostrata, commonly known as Cleft Finger Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Cleft Finger Grass include its ability to calm digestive issues, reduce anxiety and stress, and support the immune system. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant for traditional medicine.
